name: wealth-circle-uniapp
description: 财富星球移动端 (UniApp) - 适配 H5 与 iOS/Android App

scripts.build:ios: UNI_INPUT_DIR=$PWD uni build && rm -rf ios/WealthPlanet/www && cp -R dist/build/h5 ios/WealthPlanet/www && cd ios && xcodegen generate
scripts.install:ios: npm run build:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/WealthPlanet.xcodeproj -scheme WealthPlanet -destination 'id=00008130-000465863AD2001C' -derivedDataPath ./ios/build build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008130-000465863AD2001C ios/build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/财富星球.app && xcrun devicectl device process launch --device 00008130-000465863AD2001C --terminate-existing sdy.wealthplanet
